## Context
The duration probe can measure end-to-end close wall time and the verifier workflow, but it currently labels the large interval before the completion verdict as an inferred residual. That attribution is insufficient: a recent normal close was silent for roughly eight minutes, and existing cohorts have much larger gaps. Minimal direct instrumentation is approved only if it cannot exacerbate the performance problem.

## Performance constraint
Instrumentation must use only `time.monotonic_ns()`, integer arithmetic, and cheap dictionary assignments on the existing call path. It must add no event, tracker write, commit/push, file read, Git command, network call, tracing backend, worker, lock, retry, sleep, or model call. The values must piggyback on the existing `COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics` payload and its existing sidecar write. A standard-library microbenchmark must show the complete added bookkeeping costs less than 50 microseconds per close, well under 0.01% of a one-minute close, and the command/result must be recorded before landing.

## Plan
- Start one timing dictionary at `close_ticket` entry. Thread it through the exact existing graph: `close_ticket → _completion_precheck → _check_work_landed → {_referencing_commits → commit_impact.referencing_commits, _check_file_impact_vs_diff}`. Every new argument is optional. Keep `close_precheck._referencing_commits` as the documented monkeypatch/compatibility seam.
- Record direct milliseconds for `pre_verifier_total_ms`, `structural_scan_ms`, `material_policy_ms`, `descendant_scope_ms`, `landing_check_ms`, `verifier_call_ms`, `git_history_read_ms`, `alias_index_build_ms`, `ticket_ref_resolution_ms`, and `diff_validation_ms`.
- In `commit_impact.referencing_commits`, time only the already-existing Git-log subprocess wait, alias-index build, and cached reference-resolution loop. Count already-iterated commits, distinct extracted references, and found referencing commits; do not add a second traversal.
- In `_check_file_impact_vs_diff`, time the existing impact union plus attached/referencing commit changed-path and undeclared-path scan directly inside that function. No work is duplicated for measurement.
- Resolve the canonical ticket plus transitive descendants once as today, recording the scope time and accepted descendant-id count during the same loop.
- Measure the existing bounded completion-verifier/auto-resume call. Immediately after it returns, merge the direct fields into its existing `metrics` dictionary before the existing PASS/FAIL sidecar emit, preserving consumption metrics from gate dispatch.
- Update the reusable duration probe to read the direct fields. Records lacking them are `legacy_uninstrumented`; an unexplained legacy residual is never assigned a causal operation name.
- Add synthetic RED-first tests for timing propagation, counts, existing-metric preservation, optional-argument compatibility, direct/legacy probe reporting, and unchanged counts of existing subprocess and sidecar calls.

## Timing boundaries
- `structural_scan_ms`: existing open-child/newly-unblocked batch scan in `close_ticket`.
- `material_policy_ms`: existing `_plan_review_close_recheck` currency/material policy call.
- `descendant_scope_ms`: canonical-id resolution plus transitive descendant collection/resolution.
- `landing_check_ms`: existing `_check_work_landed` call.
- `verifier_call_ms`: existing `verify_with_auto_resume` call.
- `pre_verifier_total_ms`: `close_ticket` entry through the instant immediately before `verify_with_auto_resume`.
- `git_history_read_ms`, `alias_index_build_ms`, and `ticket_ref_resolution_ms`: the named existing sections of `commit_impact.referencing_commits`.
- `diff_validation_ms`: the existing changed-path/undeclared-path scan inside `_check_file_impact_vs_diff`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A model-backed PASS `COMPLETION_VERDICT` carries all ten direct timing fields.
- [x] A model-backed FAIL `COMPLETION_VERDICT` carries all ten direct timing fields.
- [x] Existing completion consumption metrics remain present and unchanged.
- [x] Sidecar workload counts report commits inspected, distinct references, descendant ids, and referencing commits found.
- [x] Instrumentation adds no I/O, subprocess, network call, tracker event/write, or model call.
- [x] Instrumentation adds no lock, retry, sleep, tracing backend, or background worker.
- [x] Existing callers behave unchanged when no optional timing dictionary is supplied.
- [x] The duration probe consumes direct fields when present.
- [x] Older probe rows are labeled `legacy_uninstrumented` without a causal label for their residual.
- [x] Synthetic tests fail on current main and pass after implementation.
- [x] A standard-library microbenchmark measures the complete added bookkeeping below 50 microseconds per close.
- [x] Focused tests and the script import walk pass.
- [x] Lint, typecheck, and the default non-integration/non-external test suite pass.
- [x] Agent-duration guidance remains unchanged pending explicit user confirmation after a post-instrumentation cohort.
